players.product: 400G/800G data-center Ethernet switches for AI computing clusters (128-port 800G box switch; 51.2T CPO co-packaged switch solution), plus 1.6T/800G optical modules

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, board secretary Yao Bin): January-September 2026 revenue RMB 145.96 hundred million (+36.66%) and net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 10.81 hundred million (+58.87%). By segment: network equipment about RMB 133.77 hundred million (+44.32%), network security about RMB 3.79 hundred million (+11.32%), cloud desktop about RMB 3.56 hundred million (-3.73%); domestic about RMB 115.55 hundred million (+30.66%) and overseas about RMB 30.41 hundred million (+65.60%, 20.83% of revenue); direct sales, mainly internet data centers, about RMB 94.81 hundred million (64.96%, +54.88%) and distribution about RMB 51.14 hundred million (+12.20%). The expense ratio fell to 24.81%, while R&D investment rose 31.26% to about RMB 17.43 hundred million (11.94% of revenue).

Management (IR record): data-center switch revenue was RMB 94.7 hundred million in January-September (+about 70%, about 65% of revenue), more than 90% of it from internet customers, mainly the three leading CSPs plus Tier 2 customers, driven by their H1 2026 capex and AI-network build-out; 400G revenue grew about 37% and 800G about 3.8 times, and 400G plus 800G reached nearly RMB 83 hundred million (about 87% of data-center revenue). Revenue so far mainly delivers 2025 framework purchases and early-2026 orders. 100G products including branded switches carry 30%-40% gross margins, while 400G / 800G white-box products are clearly lower.
quarterly_data.figure: data-center switch revenue RMB 94.7 hundred million (+about 70%); 800G revenue about 3.8 times

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): inventory rose by about RMB 60 hundred million since the start of the year, more than half of it raw materials (main switch chips, memory, circuit boards), for delivery, supply-situation stocking and large customers' requests for rolling stocking on top of existing orders; chips and memory have been relatively tight since 2025. Demand for Broadcom TH5 chips is high and supply has stayed tight from 2025 into 2026 without fundamental improvement, but strategic framework purchase agreements and early stocking prevented any delivery disruption, there was no Q3 delivery bottleneck for internet customers, and stocking for 2027 is being planned on a rolling basis. As the company understands, domestic chips targeting TH5 are expected to complete tape-out only in Q4 2026. Raw-material price increases had little impact on gross margin through Q3; the company issued price-increase notices but absorbs part of the cost.
quarterly_data.figure: inventory up about RMB 60 hundred million since the start of 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): in September 2026 Ruijie launched the RG-ETH 128 super-node solution (up to 128 GPUs per rack, 3.2Tbps Ethernet bandwidth per GPU, 250 ns switch chip) and an 800V high-voltage DC rack power solution; 400G LPO is in volume delivery and 1.6T LPO prototypes exist, sold only with Ruijie's own switches; NPO in 3.2T and 6.4T forms should have test samples by year-end, with 102.4T four-chip NPO switch and 3.2T NPO module prototypes. Super-node products, shipped as switch trays (400G / 800G) mostly to cloud providers, were below 2% of Q3 revenue; full-rack super-node volume production is expected in H1 2027 with only samples in Q4 2026, and Ruijie will later launch its own super-node server rack.
quarterly_data.figure: super-node products below 2% of Q3 revenue

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): overseas revenue of about RMB 30 hundred million in January-September grew about 60%, covering more than 140 countries mainly through SMB and enterprise campus customers (switches, gateways, wireless APs), with very few North American customers and historical overseas growth above 30% a year. Memory price increases mainly affect cloud desktop products, a small share of revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: overseas revenue about RMB 30 hundred million (+about 60%)

players.product: Tomahawk 5 switch ASIC and PAM4 DSP

contracts.signal: Ruijie Networks IR record: Ruijie has more than ten years of cooperation with upstream chip maker Broadcom; demand for Broadcom TH5 chips is high and supply has been tight since 2025, which Ruijie manages through strategic framework purchase agreements and early stocking.
